title: Common Types — Child-Safety Control Evidence Schema v0.1
description: Shared $defs referenced by cer.schema.json, ror.schema.json, and the trigger-context sub-schemas. Not intended to validate a top-level document on its own.

recordId.description: Opaque unique record identifier. UUIDv4 or ULID recommended; both satisfy this pattern. Never reused across records.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC. Millisecond precision recommended.

jurisdictionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, optionally suffixed with an ISO 3166-2 subdivision (e.g. 'AU', 'US-CA').

ageBand.description: Universal, jurisdiction-neutral age band. Legal meaning is resolved by pairing this with control_context.jurisdiction and control_context.policy_version — this enum never encodes a country-specific legal threshold directly.

ageAssuranceConfidence.description: Confidence tier behind age_band. Uses a confidence-tier concept intended to remain compatible with common age-assurance approaches, including ISO/IEC 27566-1.

ageAssuranceMethodHint.description: Coarse hint only, for triage. Not a substitute for resolving the actual method via age_state.age_assurance_reference.

triggerType.description: Closed v0.1 vocabulary, scoped to access/account/age-state/jurisdiction/consent/circumvention conditions only (per Charter §7). Extension happens via a schema version bump, never a deployment-specific custom string.

actionType.description: Closed v0.1 vocabulary. Extension via schema version bump only.

evidenceMetadata.description: Integrity block shared by CER and ROR. Every record — base or linked — is independently tamper-evident.

hash_canonicalization_method.description: e.g. 'JCS-1.0' (JSON Canonicalization Scheme). Fixes how record_hash was computed.

previous_record_hash.description: Optional. Only present under the Sequential Integrity Profile. Its absence is fully v0.1-conformant — core conformance does not assume ordered, centralized persistence.
